## Claude Skills

### Agent Council
- **What it is:** A Claude Code skill that aggregates perspectives from multiple AI agents to produce a consensus-driven answer to complex queries.
- **What it does:** It coordinates a workflow where multiple AI models independently analyze a problem, then automatically synthesizes their responses into a single cohesive answer. Supports customizable agent roles, one-shot execution, and asynchronous job processing.
- **When to use it:** When you need multi-perspective validation — e.g. architectural decisions, security edge case reviews, or comparing coding approaches where a single AI opinion isn't enough.
- **Source:** https://mcpmarket.com/tools/skills/agent-council
- **Install or access:** `npx skillfish add team-attention/plugins-for-claude-natives agent-council`
